title: Launch PRD gated-review timeline with role-based owners for ambiguity resolution
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create and pilot a gated review timeline and role-owner matrix to resolve PRD ambiguities early. The goal is to reduce late-stage rework by establishing explicit checkpoints, required artifacts, and owners for engineering, design, and legal sign-offs. This ticket coordinates the pilot across two feature teams and the central legal/design reviewers and produces a short playbook and a lightweight checklist that becomes part of PRD templates.
acceptance_criteria: A pilot playbook with at least 4 discrete review gates (Triage, Scope Freeze, Pre-Implementation, Final Acceptance) is published
Each gate has a named owner from PM/ENG/DES/LEGAL and an auto-generated checklist in Confluence
Pilot completes on two active PRDs with documented time-to-resolution for ambiguity tickets reduced by >=30% compared to baseline
Rollout decision documented with list of changes to PRD template and developer onboarding notes
Security/legal sign-off process documented and initial security review completed for the pilot features
deliverables: Confluence: gate checklists and artifact templates (dataflow diagram, API contract, privacy checklist)
Two pilot PRD retros with measured metrics and lessons learned
PRD template update PR for internal repo with gating language
One 45-minute cross-team sync and recorded session for onboarding
stakeholders: Eng leads: Rafael Ortega (assignee), Mei-Ling Zhou
timeline: 2026-03-03: Kickoff meeting with ENG/DES/LEGAL; scope agreed
2026-03-08: Draft playbook and gate templates circulated for first review
2026-03-12: Pilot gate applied to Feature-A PRD and Feature-B PRD
2026-03-20: Pilot retrospective, metric analysis, and roll/no-roll recommendation
2026-03-25: Publish final playbook and update PRD template if approved
risks: Legal backlog causes delay to gate 2 sign-off
Teams treat gates as bureaucratic and bypass checklists without artifacts
Insufficient instrumentation to measure reduction in ambiguity resolution time
Scope creep: pilot expands to more PRDs and misses deadline
